en: James 1

p.src: 1  James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are in the Dispersion: Greetings.

en: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are in the Dispersion: Greetings.
u.src: 1  James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are in the Dispersion: Greetings.

en: 1:1 “Christ” means “Anointed One”.

p.src: 2  Count it all joy, my brothers, when you fall into various temptations,

en: Count it all joy, my brothers, when you fall into various temptations,
u.src: 2  Count it all joy, my brothers, when you fall into various temptations,

en: 1:2 The word for “brothers” here and where context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.”

p.src: 3  knowing that the testing of your faith produces endurance.

en: knowing that the testing of your faith produces endurance.
u.src: 3  knowing that the testing of your faith produces endurance.

p.src: 4  Let endurance have its perfect work, that you may be perfect and complete, lacking in nothing.

en: Let endurance have its perfect work, that you may be perfect and complete, lacking in nothing.
u.src: 4  Let endurance have its perfect work, that you may be perfect and complete, lacking in nothing.

p.src: 5  But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be given to him.

en: But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be given to him.
u.src: 5  But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be given to him.

p.src: 6  But let him ask in faith, without any doubting, for he who doubts is like a wave of the sea, driven by the wind and tossed.

en: But let him ask in faith, without any doubting, for he who doubts is like a wave of the sea, driven by the wind and tossed.
u.src: 6  But let him ask in faith, without any doubting, for he who doubts is like a wave of the sea, driven by the wind and tossed.

p.src: 7  For that man shouldn’t think that he will receive anything from the Lord.

en: For that man shouldn’t think that he will receive anything from the Lord.
u.src: 7  For that man shouldn’t think that he will receive anything from the Lord.

p.src: 8  He is a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways.

en: He is a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways.
u.src: 8  He is a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways.

p.src: 9  Let the brother in humble circumstances glory in his high position;

en: Let the brother in humble circumstances glory in his high position;
u.src: 9  Let the brother in humble circumstances glory in his high position;

p.src: 10  and the rich, in that he is made humble, because like the flower in the grass, he will pass away.

en: and the rich, in that he is made humble, because like the flower in the grass, he will pass away.
u.src: 10  and the rich, in that he is made humble, because like the flower in the grass, he will pass away.

p.src: 11  For the sun arises with the scorching wind and withers the grass; and the flower in it falls, and the beauty of its appearance perishes. So the rich man will also fade away in his pursuits.

en: For the sun arises with the scorching wind and withers the grass; and the flower in it falls, and the beauty of its appearance perishes. So the rich man will also fade away in his pursuits.
u.src: 11  For the sun arises with the scorching wind and withers the grass; and the flower in it falls, and the beauty of its appearance perishes. So the rich man will also fade away in his pursuits.

p.src: 12  Blessed is a person who endures temptation, for when he has been approved, he will receive the crown of life which the Lord promised to those who love him.

en: Blessed is a person who endures temptation, for when he has been approved, he will receive the crown of life which the Lord promised to those who love him.
u.src: 12  Blessed is a person who endures temptation, for when he has been approved, he will receive the crown of life which the Lord promised to those who love him.

p.src: 13  Let no man say when he is tempted, “I am tempted by God,” for God can’t be tempted by evil, and he himself tempts no one.

en: Let no man say when he is tempted, “I am tempted by God,” for God can’t be tempted by evil, and he himself tempts no one.
u.src: 13  Let no man say when he is tempted, “I am tempted by God,” for God can’t be tempted by evil, and he himself tempts no one.

p.src: 14  But each one is tempted when he is drawn away by his own lust and enticed.

en: But each one is tempted when he is drawn away by his own lust and enticed.
u.src: 14  But each one is tempted when he is drawn away by his own lust and enticed.

p.src: 15  Then the lust, when it has conceived, bears sin. The sin, when it is full grown, produces death.

en: Then the lust, when it has conceived, bears sin. The sin, when it is full grown, produces death.
u.src: 15  Then the lust, when it has conceived, bears sin. The sin, when it is full grown, produces death.

p.src: 16  Don’t be deceived, my beloved brothers.

en: Don’t be deceived, my beloved brothers.
u.src: 16  Don’t be deceived, my beloved brothers.

p.src: 17  Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation nor turning shadow.

en: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation nor turning shadow.
u.src: 17  Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation nor turning shadow.

p.src: 18  Of his own will he gave birth to us by the word of truth, that we should be a kind of first fruits of his creatures.

en: Of his own will he gave birth to us by the word of truth, that we should be a kind of first fruits of his creatures.
u.src: 18  Of his own will he gave birth to us by the word of truth, that we should be a kind of first fruits of his creatures.

p.src: 19  So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger;

en: So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger;
u.src: 19  So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger;

p.src: 20  for the anger of man doesn’t produce the righteousness of God.

en: for the anger of man doesn’t produce the righteousness of God.
u.src: 20  for the anger of man doesn’t produce the righteousness of God.

p.src: 21  Therefore, putting away all filthiness and overflowing of wickedness, receive with humility the implanted word, which is able to save your souls.

en: Therefore, putting away all filthiness and overflowing of wickedness, receive with humility the implanted word, which is able to save your souls.
u.src: 21  Therefore, putting away all filthiness and overflowing of wickedness, receive with humility the implanted word, which is able to save your souls.

en: 1:21 or, preserve your life.

p.src: 22  But be doers of the word, and not only hearers, deluding your own selves.

en: But be doers of the word, and not only hearers, deluding your own selves.
u.src: 22  But be doers of the word, and not only hearers, deluding your own selves.

p.src: 23  For if anyone is a hearer of the word and not a doer, he is like a man looking at his natural face in a mirror;

en: For if anyone is a hearer of the word and not a doer, he is like a man looking at his natural face in a mirror;
u.src: 23  For if anyone is a hearer of the word and not a doer, he is like a man looking at his natural face in a mirror;

p.src: 24  for he sees himself, and goes away, and immediately forgets what kind of man he was.

en: for he sees himself, and goes away, and immediately forgets what kind of man he was.
u.src: 24  for he sees himself, and goes away, and immediately forgets what kind of man he was.

p.src: 25  But he who looks into the perfect law of freedom and continues, not being a hearer who forgets but a doer of the work, this man will be blessed in what he does.

en: But he who looks into the perfect law of freedom and continues, not being a hearer who forgets but a doer of the work, this man will be blessed in what he does.
u.src: 25  But he who looks into the perfect law of freedom and continues, not being a hearer who forgets but a doer of the work, this man will be blessed in what he does.

p.src: 26  If anyone among you thinks himself to be religious while he doesn’t bridle his tongue, but deceives his heart, this man’s religion is worthless.

en: If anyone among you thinks himself to be religious while he doesn’t bridle his tongue, but deceives his heart, this man’s religion is worthless.
u.src: 26  If anyone among you thinks himself to be religious while he doesn’t bridle his tongue, but deceives his heart, this man’s religion is worthless.

p.src: 27  Pure religion and undefiled before our God and Father is this: to visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep oneself unstained by the world.

en: Pure religion and undefiled before our God and Father is this: to visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep oneself unstained by the world.
u.src: 27  Pure religion and undefiled before our God and Father is this: to visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep oneself unstained by the world.
